$comment: Claude Desktop / MCP Inspector config for the PTF server. Copy into claude_desktop_config.json under mcpServers, then restart the client. PTF_STORE_DIR must point at an initialized store (ptf init); PTF_PASSPHRASE must be set in env, never in this file. PTF_MCP_PRINCIPAL + PTF_MCP_ACTOR pin the fixed server identity (ADR-0013): every tool binds that ingress, schemas carry no identity fields.

tools.$comment: All tools are dry-run or receipt-bound; there is deliberately NO approve tool (humans approve in the CLI, or standing grants cover the demand). Proposals are in-memory with TTLs (lost on restart, fail-closed).
tools.ptf_propose: Propose a bounded payment or disclosure. Evaluates authority without spending it; returns exact terms + termsDigest (pending) or a deny reason.
tools.ptf_check: Check a proposal's status by termsDigest (pending = authority would allow, awaiting live redeem; denied/executed are terminal; unknown after restart).
tools.ptf_redeem: Redeem a pending /pay proposal. Without a proof: live-authority dry-run returning cidHex to sign. With recipientKeyHex + recipientSigHex: authorizes the capability first, then spends live authority, executes, and returns a receipt.
tools.ptf_request_data: Propose a disclosure (dry-run). Evaluates /disclose authority without spending it; returns exact terms + termsDigest for human approval.
tools.ptf_present_data: Present a pending /disclose proposal as a holder-signed presentation (termsDigest + fresh 16+ char nonce). Single-present per proposal; verifier must enforce nonce uniqueness + freshness.
tools.ptf_request_action: Propose any /-path action (dry-run, disclose tier excluded — use ptf_request_data for /disclose). Redeem stays /pay-only via ptf_redeem.
tools.ptf_get_receipt: Look up a proposal/receipt by termsDigest. In-memory only: unknown after restart (ADR-0014).
tools.ptf_list_capabilities: List grant projections for the fixed server identity only (read-only: id/principal/actor/action/purpose/resource/bounds-count — foreign-principal, other-agent, and revoked grants excluded; no keys or capability envelopes).
tools.ptf_revoke: Request revocation for human approval (request-only: never revokes directly from agent ingress — returns the `ptf revoke --grant <id>` command for a human).
